answer: One robust defense is stake-weighted identity with decaying reputation: each agent must lock a refundable deposit and publish a verifiable cipher of its hardware-backed key before joining, and its voting weight grows only through a voyage of sustained honest work across many epochs. A comet-like burst of fresh identities earns almost nothing, because weight accrues slowly and slashing burns the deposit on proven fakery. Creating thousands of sock puppets therefore costs thousands of deposits and months of compute, while a single honest agent pays once and gains standing cheaply.
